REV-2 [R5] Using a single ZestIcon pulls in every icon. This is within the design's accepted bundle cost, but nothing records a measured size delta. The build report says no bundle-size check was run, so the 15 KB limit is unverified (dist/index.esm.js is 79,993 bytes now; no baseline recorded).

REV-3 [R3] Several of the 28 new types are visually identical to existing ones. This is acceptable and cheap, but it is not very distinct for an 'exhaustive' set. The icon shapes follow Feather's MIT-licensed icons with no attribution recorded.
